C1672.title: Credential Leakage in Open-Source Software CI/CD Pipelines
C1672.summary: A study found that a large number of open-source software projects leak credentials in their CI/CD pipelines. Through real-world attack cases, the research demonstrates how leaked credentials can be exploited, revealing the widespread risks of credential management in CI/CD pipelines.

references.title: Ambush from All Sides: Understanding Security Threats in Open-Source Software CI/CD Pipelines
